schema:name: laQicpms protocol — P6
schema:description: laQicpmsTAPP instance derived from Wu+etal2023 | Analyte G2 + iCAP TQ ICP-MS/MS | IGGCAS (publication column of LA-Q-ICP-MS_TAPP_v71.csv).

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Target Material
schema:value: Xenotime, apatite and garnet — accessory and metamorphic minerals for in situ Lu-Hf geochronology

schema:additionalType: Triple quadrupole (ICP-MS/MS) — operated in both single-quadrupole (SQ) and triple-quadrupole (TQ) modes

schema:model.schema:name: iCap TQ ICP-MS/MS (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Bremen, Germany)

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Configuration
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: High sensitivity sample and skimmer cones

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Sampler and Skimmer Cone Material
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: N — 'high sensitivity' cones specified, material not stated

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Cell Exit Discrimination Voltage
schema:additionalProperty.schema:description: CR exit lens -40.00 V (cell bias -4.200 V, CR amplitude 189.3 V, CR entry lens -144.0 V also tabulated)

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Reaction Gas Type
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: NH3, high purity (>99.999%), supplied in T4; He (>99.999%, T1) pre-mixed with NH3 before the cell in a test of mixture composition. High-purity NH3 found more effective than the commonly used 1:9 NH3-He mixture

schema:hasPart.schema:name: ICP-MS/MS (triple-quadrupole mode) with NH3 reaction gas for analysis; tuning first performed in single-quadrupole (SQ) no-gas mode

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Detector Configuration
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Single SEM in double mode, counting and analog

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: ICP Tuning
schema:additionalProperty.schema:defaultValue: Two-stage: first optimised in solution single-quadrupole and no-gas modes to tune for a robust plasma (U/Th = 1.00-1.05) and minimise oxides (ThO/Th < 0.5%); then switched to TQ and NH3 mode, with lenses tuned to maximise sensitivity for Hf reaction products while keeping Lu and Yb reaction rates low

schema:instrument.schema:name: example instrumentName

schema:model.schema:name: Photon Machines Analyte G2 (Teledyne CETAC, Omaha, USA)

ada:carrierGasFlowRateDefault: He, 900 mL min-1 ablation gas flow

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Make-up Gas and Flow Rate
schema:additionalProperty.schema:description: N2 enhancement gas, 4.0 mL min-1, added to the carrier gas after the sample chamber to enhance sensitivity; an 80% sensitivity improvement is reported

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Uncertainty Propagation Method
schema:additionalProperty.schema:defaultValue: Uncertainty propagation workflow implemented in IsoplotR

ada:backgroundCountTimeDefault: N — gas-blank correction applied in Iolite, duration not stated

schema:step.schema:name: Sample preparation
schema:step.schema:description: Megacrysts and single crystals; XN02 megacrysts from the Datas alluvial deposits, SE Brazil

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Analysis Inclusion and Rejection Criteria
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Acquired and included counts both stated: 'A total of 246 spot analyses were undertaken in 20 analytical sessions over 3 months, 236 of which yielded a weighted-mean age of 515.4 +/- 1.2 Ma'. The rejection rule itself is not stated

ada:constantsAndReferenceValuesUsedDefau: NIST SRM 610 recommended values 176Lu/177Hf = 0.1379 +/- 0.0050 and 176Hf/177Hf = 0.282111 +/- 0.000009, as determined by ID-MC-ICP-MS; 176Lu/175Lu = 0.02655; 176Yb/172Yb = 0.5887; 177Hf/178Hf = 0.682; 176Lu half-life ~37.12 Ga

schema:location.schema:name: Institute of Geology and Geophysics, Chinese Academy of Sciences (IGGCAS)

ada:samplingUnit: Laser spot — 246 spot analyses on XN02 alone; spot diameters 50-150 um depending on Lu and Hf contents

bios:computationalTool.schema:name: Iolite v.3.7 for gas-blank-corrected intensities, raw ratios and uncertainties; an in-house Microsoft Excel spreadsheet for drift, elemental fractionation and matrix-induced bias; IsoplotR for isochron and weighted-mean ages

ada:reportedProperties: 176Lu/177Hf and 176Hf/177Hf ratios; Lu-Hf isochron and weighted-mean ages (Ma)
ada:ablationSamplingMode: Single hole drilling, two cleaning pulses
ada:uncertaintyLevel: 2SE for single-spot ages; uncertainties on weighted-mean ages quoted at 2s
ada:oxideProductionMethodAndThreshold: ThO/Th < 0.5%, checked during SQ no-gas tuning
ada:blankBackgroundCorrectionMethod: Gas-blank-corrected intensities calculated in Iolite v.3.7 from time-resolved intensities
ada:secondaryReferenceMaterialDefault: XN02 xenotime as a matrix-matched reference material to correct matrix-induced elemental fractionation of Lu/Hf between SRM 610 and the samples
